title: ProviderCapability
description: A standing declaration of what a provider can do, changed rarely. This is what turns the knowledge that today sits only in the head of a planner into something a system can match on, and what lets a company that is new or small be found without first having to be remembered. One schema for every kind of provider, discriminated on providerType, because recovery matching, transporter matching and garage selection are all the same read. Held in the eVault of the provider organisation, which is the only party entitled to declare it.

canonicalOwnerEName.description: eName of the provider organisation eVault

providerEName.description: eName of the provider organisation making the declaration

providerType.description: assistance, coordination and roadAuthority are bare declarations of what an organisation is, with no service block: the SAMN apps admit only staff of an organisation that declares the app's kind. A roadAuthority publishes RoadSection records and the roadAuthorityRecovery Agreements for them.

operatingArea.description: Where the provider works. Either a radius from a base, or named regions, or both.

baseLat.description: Latitude of the provider's base in decimal degrees (WGS 84)

baseLon.description: Longitude of the provider's base in decimal degrees (WGS 84)

radiusKm.description: How far from the base the provider works, in kilometres

regions.description: Names of the regions the provider works in

countries.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes of the countries the provider works in

crossBorder.description: Whether the provider takes work that crosses a national border

certifications.description: For example EV-safe handling, heavy recovery, hazardous load

responseTimeCommitmentMinutes.description: How many minutes after accepting a job the provider commits to being on scene

maxLiftKg.description: Heaviest vehicle the fleet can lift, in kilograms

maxTowKg.description: Heaviest vehicle the fleet can tow, in kilograms

towingMethods.description: Towing methods the fleet can perform

winching.description: Whether the provider can winch a vehicle that cannot roll

evContainment.description: Whether the provider can carry a damaged electric vehicle with containment against a battery fire

heavyRecovery.description: Whether the provider recovers trucks, buses and other heavy vehicles

hazardousGoods.description: Whether the provider may recover vehicles carrying hazardous goods

maxVehicleHeightMm.description: Tallest vehicle the fleet can carry, in millimetres

tunnelRestricted.description: Whether the fleet is barred from some tunnels, for example by height or a hazardous load

bridgeWeightLimitKg.description: Bridge weight limit the loaded truck stays under, in kilograms, so routes over weight-limited bridges can be checked

recovery.description: What the provider can recover. Required when providerType is recovery.

maxWeightKgPerSlot.description: Heaviest vehicle one place can take, in kilograms

maxLengthMm.description: Longest vehicle one place can take, in millimetres

maxHeightMm.description: Tallest vehicle one place can take, in millimetres

covered.description: Whether the provider has enclosed transporters

canLoadNonRolling.description: Whether the provider can load a vehicle that cannot roll

evCapable.description: Whether the provider may carry a damaged electric vehicle

transport.description: What the provider can transport. Required when providerType is transport.

brands.description: Vehicle makes the garage is approved or equipped for. Empty means all makes.

mechanical.description: Whether the garage does mechanical repairs

glass.description: Whether the garage replaces and repairs glass

mot.description: Whether the garage carries out the periodic roadworthiness test, such as the MOT or APK

adasCalibration.description: Whether the garage can calibrate driver-assistance cameras and sensors after a repair

evCertified.description: Whether the garage is certified to work on high-voltage electric vehicles

courtesyVehicles.description: Whether the garage lends a car to the driver during the repair

equipmentHeld.description: Lifts, alignment benches, calibration rigs, diagnostic tooling, EV workshop equipment. Summarised here rather than modelled as individual assets, which would be more precise but far heavier to maintain.

repair.description: What the garage can repair. Required when providerType is repair.

serviceTypes.description: Kinds of onward transport the provider offers

vehicleClasses.description: Rental classes of the replacement cars offered, such as compact, estate or van

maxSeats.description: Most seats in one vehicle the provider offers, driver included

wheelchairAccessible.description: Whether the provider has wheelchair-accessible vehicles

childSeatsAvailable.description: Whether the provider supplies child seats

minDriverAge.description: Youngest age at which a driver may be given a replacement car

licenceClassesAccepted.description: Driving licence classes a driver may hold to be given a replacement car, such as B

tariffs.description: What the provider charges (FR-DM-14), so the driver sees the price and what they pay before choosing (FR-DM-06). Absent: the provider quotes no published price.

baseFare.description: Fixed amount per ride, in currency

taxi.description: Taxi fare: baseFare plus perKm times the distance

replacementVehicle.description: Price per day for each vehicle class offered

vehicleClass.description: The rental class this price is for

deliveryFee.description: Bringing the car to the driver and collecting it again

minimumFare.description: Lowest fare charged for a journey, in currency

publicTransport.description: Public transport fare: perKm times the distance, at least minimumFare

mobility.description: What onward transport the provider offers. Required when providerType is mobility.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Conditions a vehicle must meet to be accepted, one entry per condition

acceptsEv.description: Whether damaged electric vehicles are accepted

acceptsHazardous.description: Whether vehicles with a hazardous load or a fluid leak are accepted

insurerAgreementEnvelopeIds.description: Agreements the provider is party to, since those constrain which work can be sent to it

validFrom.description: When the declaration starts to apply

validUntil.description: When the declaration stops applying. Null or absent means open-ended.

createdAt.description: When the record was first written

updatedAt.description: When the record was last changed

revision.description: Starts at 1 and goes up by one on every change to the record
